subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: What policy should live provider text catalogs use for default visibility, allowlists, capability metadata, cache/offline behavior, and unknown-model execution?
rationale: The repository already has the necessary provider hooks, but switching from a small static catalog to a large mutable provider catalog changes safety, cost controls, UX, compatibility, and the public plugin contract.

options.title: Curated live catalogs
options.body: Fetch through the existing provider catalog hook, cache with an owned bounded lifecycle, show a curated subset by default, and allow explicit full selection.

options.title: Full live catalogs
options.body: Expose every fetched provider model in list and picker surfaces and rely on filters or user allowlists to control the result.

options.title: Dynamic execution only
options.body: Keep arbitrary explicitly configured model execution but leave normal model discovery static and scan-oriented.

recommendation.title: Curated live catalogs
recommendation.body: Fetch through the existing provider catalog hook, cache with an owned bounded lifecycle, show a curated subset by default, and allow explicit full selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this owner most directly to model-catalog unification and OpenRouter metadata and discovery behavior.
